metaDescription: Drop in your résumé, deck, portfolio or a few links. Onward Scout builds your profile from them, then you tap to confirm and pick what you want next.
claimingBody: Moving your files, profile and goals into your account. This takes a few seconds.
claimFailed: We couldn't move your draft into your account
confirmFailed: Your profile didn't save as confirmed. Your taps are kept — try again from your profile page.

drop.title: Drop what you have
drop.lede: A résumé, a CV, a pitch deck, a portfolio, a few links — whatever already exists. We read it so you never have to type it again.
drop.skip: I don't have anything to upload
drop.privacy: Your files are private: we use them to build your profile, and they go to an organisation only when you approve. Our analytics tool may record this page, uploads included (Cookie settings). You can delete any of it at any time.

upload.dropTypes: PDF, Word, PowerPoint, text, Markdown, JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 20 MB each · up to {max} files
upload.rejectType: That file type isn't supported. Use PDF, Word, PowerPoint, text, Markdown or an image.
upload.rejectSize: This file is over 20 MB. Export a smaller copy and drop it again.
upload.rejectCount: You can add up to {max} files here.
upload.uploadFailed: The upload stopped. Check your connection and try again.
upload.reparseFailed: We couldn't start reading it again
upload.linksInvalid: Paste a full address, like github.com/yourname.
upload.readDone: Read. Nothing to add from this one yet.
upload.linksHint: Your website, GitHub, ORCID, portfolio, Behance, a company or product page. Several at once is fine.
upload.linkSavedOnly: Saved as a link. This site can't be read automatically.
upload.linkedinBody: We keep the link, but to import your profile open it on LinkedIn, choose More → Save to PDF, and drop that PDF above.
upload.notePlaceholder: e.g. Looking for remote product roles in Europe from March

status.readingFile: Reading {name}…{more, plural, =0 {} one { and # more} other { and # more}}
status.hint: Facts appear here as we find them. Every one keeps a link to where it came from.

card.title: Is this you?
card.lede: Tap anything that's wrong. Every tap saves at once.
card.ledeBuilding: We're still reading. Tap what you already know — the rest fills in as we go.
card.noSourcesBody: Tap who you are and where you are. You can add a résumé or links later from your profile.
card.needRole: Pick at least one thing you are to continue.
card.noRoles: Nothing picked yet. Choose a group below.
card.occupationPlaceholder: Search: designer, 产品经理, nurse…
card.occupationNone: No match yet. Try another word or a shorter title.
card.guardianHint: You're under 18, so we need a parent or guardian's email before your first submission. It's kept on your profile and never used for marketing.
card.guardianInvalid: That email address doesn't look right.

goals.title: What do you want next?
goals.lede: Pick what you're going for and what success looks like. We plan the weeks from there.
goals.familiesHint: Pre-selected from who you are. Tap to change; you can run more than one.
goals.moreGoals: {count, plural, one {# more goal} other {# more goals}}
goals.subTitle: Which one exactly?
goals.successHint: Pick one, or write your own in one line.
goals.footnote: You'll see your first picks right away. Nothing is sent without your tap.
goals.footnoteSignedOut: Next: save your scout with your email so it keeps working for you.

save.title: Save your scout
save.body: Enter your email on the next screen and we'll send you a one-time code. No password.
save.point1: Your files, profile and goals move into your account as they are.
save.point2: Your first picks are ready as soon as you're in.
save.point3: Nothing is ever sent without your tap.

flow.finishingBody: Saving your answers and finding your first picks.

goal.title: What are you going for?
goal.hint: Pick one to start. You can add more goals later.
goal.more: {count, plural, one {# more option} other {# more options}}

role.title: Which role do you want?
role.hint: Pick up to three. We look for these first.
role.search: Search a role: product manager, nurse, 设计师…
role.none: No match yet. Try the full job title, like “product manager”.

remote.title: Do you need a remote job?
remote.hint: If you do, we leave out on-site and hybrid roles.

where.title: Where are you based?
where.hint: We use it to check where you can apply and to rank roles near you higher.

guardian.title: A parent or guardian's email
guardian.hint: You're under 18, so we need it before your first application goes out. It's never used for marketing.
guardian.invalid: That email address doesn't look right.

flow.reading: Still reading your files. Answers they show will be pre-selected for you.

situation.title: What do you do right now?
situation.hint: Pick the one that fits best today.
situation.F: I'm building a startup or business
situation.P: I'm a licensed professional (doctor, lawyer, teacher…)
situation.T: I'm between jobs or changing direction

detail.F: Where is your startup or business?
detail.C: What kind of work do you do?

flow.detailHint: Programs often limit who can apply, so this keeps your list honest.

extraHint.F: These programs are for founders, so we need this too.
